test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The question is why an ______ Hollywood film should provoke such a hostile reaction.
solution: The correct answer is **"innocuous."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Innocuous"** means not harmful or offensive. (अहानिकर, सीधा-सादा) • **Example:** *I made an **innocuous**__ remark about teachers and she got really angry.* • The sentence is questioning why a harmless Hollywood film would receive such negative reactions. • Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. ​ **Correct sentence: ***The question is why an __**innocuous**__ Hollywood film should provoke such a hostile reaction.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let us explore other options: • **"Elicit"** means to evoke or draw out a response or reaction. (किसी से सूचना, तथ्‍य आदि निकलवाना) • **"Obstinate"** means stubborn or refusing to change one's opinion. (दूसरों के लाख कहने पर भी, अपनी बात से न हटने वाला व्यक्ति; हठी, दुराग्रही) • **"Erroneous"** means incorrect or mistaken. (अशुद्घ; ग़लत सूचना पर आधारित) 1c1:Tb1c, The correct answer is **"quick."**
